card.name: rover_contact_grc1_viper
card.description: Physics-informed surrogate (random-Fourier-feature residual tanh MLP, 4 blocks x 96) of the Wong-Reece rigid-wheel model for the NASA VIPER wheel (R 0.25 m, b 0.20 m, 24 grousers, parametric model from public figures) on GRC-1 lunar simulant, with slip-sinkage (sinkage exponent n = n0 + n1 s, Ding et al. 2010/2011; GRC-1 n1 = 0.8). Inputs slip and sinkage, outputs drawbar pull, normal load and driving torque. Trained with soft constraints dFz/dz >= 0, dFx/ds >= 0 (slip <= 0.3), Mohr-Coulomb traction limit and My >= R Fx. The exact physics configuration it was trained on is recorded in data_lineage.physics and config.json (checked by ZooContactSurrogate.check_physics).
card.task: Wheel-soil contact forces of a rigid grousered wheel on lunar regolith simulant (terramechanics)

inputs.name: sinkage_m
inputs.description: static + slip sinkage of the wheel

outputs.name: Fz_N
outputs.description: normal load carried by the soil

validity_range.wheel: VIPER wheel, R 0.25 m, b 0.20 m, 24 grousers
validity_range.physics: Wong-Reece with slip-sinkage n = n0 + n1 s on driving slip (GRC-1: n0 0.8, n1 0.8); steady state, so the slip that sets the exponent equals the slip

known_limitations: Only as good as the Wong-Reece model: against published single-wheel tests the model's drawbar pull RMSE is 4-14 N (digitised data), larger than the surrogate's own error.
One soil and one wheel; zero slip angle (no lateral force); steady state.
Slip-sinkage makes the forces kink at zero slip (the exponent grows only with driving slip); the network smooths the kink over a small slip interval.
equations: Wong-Reece rigid wheel on deformable soil (Bekker pressure-sinkage, Janosi-Hanamoto shear)
card.reference_source: 2000 held-out Latin-hypercube states (seed 1000, disjoint from training) of the Wong-Reece model evaluated by adaptive quadrature (analytic reference). The Wong-Reece implementation is compared with published single-wheel tests (Ding et al. 2011; Wang & Han 2016; dataset single_wheel_tests).
card.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). Wheel-soil contact PINN surrogate (Wong-Reece, GRC-1, VIPER wheel). PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle
